### Microsoft Copilot and the Enterprise usage of AI

At the end of September 2025, I delivered a presentation to the broader product marketing department with my colleague Jacob \- called “GenAI Tools for Modern Tech Marketers”.

The focus then was on Microsoft Copilot capabilities, as those were more widely available in the organisation. It covered the following personas and use cases:

- Product Manager  
- Developer  
- Outbound Marketer

#### Product managers can now become more strategic and analytical

Microsoft 365 Copilot offers a few tools that are particularly useful for product managers. In this section I will cover two of those: the researcher and the analyst.

![][image1]

The first capability that was introduced to the department was **deep research**, a capability introduced by ChatGPT and Perplexity in early 2025\.

![][image2]

The second capability is the **analyst**. This is an implementation of the same concept as the Data Analysis capabilities in ChatGPT[^1] but integrated in the Microsoft 365 environment, with access to all of your Excel files. To illustrate this I analyzed product usage sliced and diced over different dimensions

## Week 1: a strategic entry into the Claude ecosystem

Before diving into Claude Code, I started with Claude Desktop.  
The Desktop app is a very approachable interface for those who come from chat apps like ChatGPT.

The first question you ask yourself is: What kind of project can I tackle with Claude?

The type of tasks that I tackled with Claude Desktop was more more around strategy and competitive analysis than coding related (at first). I created a presentation on the impact of agentic AI on the market of scientific and technical computing \- something that most companies must be asking themselves now.

### Thinking strategically

Here is a diagram extracted from this presentation that describes the chasm that exists between the early adopters of agentic AI, evaluating solutions like Claude, and the majority that is still associating AI with the chatbots like ChatGPT. 

![][image4]  
Early Adopters vs. The Majority  
The shift from language models, often associated with chatbots, to advanced agentic AI, such as Claude, represents a significant divergence in how technology is utilized for knowledge work.

| Characteristic | Early Adopters of Agentic AI (e.g., Claude) | The Majority (Associating AI with Chatbots like ChatGPT) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Primary Perception** | A strategic co-pilot, workflow automation tool, and code-centric partner. | A general-purpose conversational interface for quick answers and simple text generation. |
| **Core Use Case** | Complex, multi-step tasks, specialized coding projects, competitive analysis, and strategic document generation. | Information retrieval, drafting emails/simple content, and basic brainstorming. |
| **Technical Focus** | Emphasizes structured inputs, context management, custom commands, and skills for repeatable workflows. | Focuses on natural language prompting in a chat environment, often relying on a single conversational thread. |
| **Desired Outcome** | Qualitative, actionable, and integrated output that saves significant time on complex processes. | Quick, usable output that speeds up individual, isolated tasks. |
| **Engagement Model** | Deep integration into daily tools and development environments (e.g., VS Code extension). | Primarily web-based or through mobile applications. |

This gap illustrates a maturity curve where early adopters are already moving beyond simple conversational AI to leverage agentic capabilities for high-value strategic and technical computing tasks. Bridging this chasm requires demonstrating the tangible, strategic value of agentic AI workflows, particularly how they enable domain experts (like those in scientific computing) to achieve outcomes previously considered too complex or time-consuming to automate.

### /commands

![][image9]

**Commands vs skills**

| Aspect | Commands | Skills |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Invocation | Manual: /command | Automatic: Claude decides |
| Structure | Single .md file | Directory with SKILL.md |
| Location | .claude/commands/ | .claude/skills/ |
| Discovery | User must type command | Claude matches description |
| Supporting files | Not supported | Load on demand |
| Best for | Quick templates | Complex workflows |
